## Learning goals

- run Quarto chunks;
- use vectors, tibbles, and dplyr verbs;
- load `fpp3` and plot `aus_production`.

## 1. Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
```

## 2. Calculator and vectors

```{r}
sales <- c(10, 12, 11, 15, 14)
mean(sales)
lag(sales)
```

## 3. A tiny tibble

```{r}
df <- tibble(time = 1:5, sales = sales)
df |> mutate(lag1 = lag(sales)) |> filter(sales >= 12)
```

## 4. First time plot

```{r}
aus_production |>
  autoplot(Beer) +
  labs(title = "Australian beer production", y = "Megalitres")
```
